definitions.explanation: The ratio of the height to the width of a rectangular image, screen, or object. Used for displays, photos, video formats, and printed materials.

examples.japanese: {縦横比|たてよこひ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{保|たも}って→保つ：10134_tamotsu⟧⟦{拡大|かくだい}→拡大：02553_kakudai⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Enlarge while preserving the aspect ratio.

examples.japanese: ⟦テレビ→テレビ：01536_terebi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{縦横比|たてよこひ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧16:9⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{標準|ひょうじゅん}→標準：04832_hyoujun⟧だ。
examples.english: The standard television aspect ratio is 16:9.

examples.japanese: ⟦{画像|がぞう}→画像：13549_gazou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{縦横比|たてよこひ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{変|か}える→変える：01089_kaeru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、{被写体|ひしゃたい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{歪|ゆが}んで→歪む：04246_yugamu⟧⟦{見|み}える→見える：01165_mieru⟧。
examples.english: If you change the aspect ratio of the image, the subject will appear distorted.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{縦|たて}→縦：17236_tate⟧ (vertical) + ⟦{横|よこ}→横：02984_yoko⟧ (horizontal) + ⟦{比|ひ}→比：30310_hi⟧ (ratio). Often expressed as a ratio (16:9, 4:3) rather than a decimal.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {縦横比|たてよこひ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{保|たも}つ→保つ：10134_tamotsu⟧: to maintain the aspect ratio
- {縦横比|たてよこひ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{変|か}える→変える：01089_kaeru⟧: to change the aspect ratio
- ⟦{画面|がめん}→画面：04406_gamen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{縦横比|たてよこひ}: screen aspect ratio
- {縦横比|たてよこひ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{合|あ}わない→合う：10466_au⟧: the aspect ratio doesn't match

SIMILAR WORDS:
- アスペクト⟦{比|ひ}→比：30310_hi⟧: aspect ratio — loanword equivalent, common in technical contexts
- ⟦{比率|ひりつ}→比率：06727_hiritsu⟧: ratio — generic term for any ratio
